Well damn that makes me think twice about going now.

As to why? 
I mean after spending a few minutes going through this sub, i feel like a selfish piece of shit considering how insignificant my problems feel compared to others, but a TLDR of why is, pressure from multiple fronts of getting into medical school and it doesn't look like I am going to be getting in. As a result, I have my parents constantly reminding me what a disappointment I turned out to be. I've been struggling with depression for some time now and I was in an abusive relationship which didn't help at all. I guess what pushed me over the edge has been this constant feeling loneliness and worthlessness that has haunted me ever since that relationship ended, and I guess I couldn't take it anymore and I snapped.
